debit.notes: Call centre runs 24x7x365 and the IVR itself hotlists debit cards (PIN holders, 12 regional languages plus Hindi and English) before an agent is reached; debit-card FAQ: block by calling customer care or via the mobile banking app. In the Union ease mobile banking app (Vyom): Pay & Transfer > Debit Card > Block/Unblock under Manage Debit card; My Profile > Smart Lock temporarily locks the Debit Card channel, and My Profile > Kill Switch is the emergency control that immediately blocks digital debit transactions (restoration requires branch intervention). Unauthorised transactions: report at unauthdigitxn.unionbankportal.bank.in (linked from Contact Us). NRI dedicated (chargeable) 02244546567; cyber-crime complaints 02244546565; premium accounts 18008331. No SMS block keyword is published on official pages.

credit.notes: Call centre runs 24x7x365; dedicated helpline for reporting fraud/disputed transactions is 18008332, and unauthorised transactions can be reported at unauthdigitxn.unionbankportal.bank.in (linked from Contact Us). In-app: the Union ease app's Kill Switch (My Profile > Kill Switch) immediately hotlists active credit cards on suspected fraud or device theft (restoration needs branch intervention and a replacement card); Smart Lock (My Profile > Smart Lock) can temporarily lock the Credit Card channel; the separate Union Credit Card app offers Card Control and Manage Card features. NRI dedicated (chargeable) 02244546567; cyber-crime complaints 02244546565; premium accounts 18008331. No SMS block keyword is published on official pages.

upi.notes: UPI runs on the Union ease app (container app for Mobile Banking + UPI). Temporary UPI lock: "Log in to the Union ease application. Navigate to My Profile section & click on Smart Lock. Select the desired channel. Choose Lock or Unlock as required." — lockable channels: Mobile Banking, Internet Banking, UPI, Debit Card, Credit Card (reversible in-app anytime). Hard stop for UPI on the account: "Block My Mobile Number" under the Block UPI IDs area of Manage UPI ID (My Profile section); FAQ: "'Block My Mobile Number' facility is available in Union ease app using which customers can block their mobile number for UPI transactions. However, for unblocking the same, customers should visit their home branch and submit the unblocking request." Unrestricting UPI likewise requires a home-branch request. Suspicious collect requests can be block-&-marked-as-spam; blocked UPI IDs are listed under Blocked UPI IDs. Emergency: the Kill Switch feature immediately blocks digital debit transactions through operative accounts and hotlists active credit cards (separate control from Smart Lock). Toll-free for UPI support per the UPI page structured data: 1800 208 2244 (site header also lists 1800 22 22 44 / 1800 22 22 43 / 1800 425 1515; charged 080-61817110; NRI +918061817110). No netbanking UPI manage path and no USSD (*99#) or SMS UPI-disable keyword published on official pages.
